title: Rework Diagnostics troubleshooting flow
summary: Reorders the Diagnostics tab around first-response troubleshooting, earlier owner-page handoff, bounded evidence, and read-only operator guidance.
reason: Operators need Diagnostics to support safe troubleshooting decisions without encouraging blind retries or Diagnostics-side pipeline-control mutation.
behavior_before: Diagnostics opened on raw logs, buried first-response and owner-page handoff evidence, and exposed a Diagnostics-side stuck-progress reset control.
behavior_after: Diagnostics opens on Overview, places first response and close readiness before deeper evidence, moves owner handoff into Investigation, keeps raw logs bounded and sourced, and removes Diagnostics-side pipeline-control mutation.
manual_validation: PYTHONPATH=src bundled Python unittest diagnostics focused suites - passed (24 tests)
change-control strict worktree coverage - failed due pre-existing invalid unrelated packets and 65 unrelated uncovered dirty files; Diagnostics packet paths recorded
rollback_plan: Revert the Diagnostics partial, WebView Diagnostics handler, lifecycle default-tab change, and focused static/mutation-boundary test updates.
notes:
Frontend-only UX remediation; no backend routes, DTO fields, diagnostics targets, or media-policy behavior are changed.
Diagnostics UX remediation: overview-first troubleshooting flow, read-only evidence posture, owner handoff earlier, and Diagnostics-side pipeline-control mutation removal.
Strict change-control validation was attempted after implementation; failures are outside this Diagnostics packet.
